Attached: 1 image

WordPress’s Abilities API is not an AI agent. It standardises how functionality is described and invoked, including inputs, outputs and permission checks.

An optional MCP Adapter can expose selected abilities to compatible AI clients. Exposure is not automatic authorisation.

https://coreblueprint.io/blog/wordpress-abilities-api-ai-agents/
